summary: Related pack (features lattice/turns/verify, claims SL-001..008, PC-013/014, prior T-006 UI trail, docs work-model/episodes) shows the bet is directionally right (TN-002 + path coverage + cheap align JSON) but several high gaps before seal: missing client/server in featureIds vs real UI/hook blast, expectedPaths/treeDigest not on schemas yet, waiver abuse, and cheap-model false-approve without a structured checklist. Worktree scan caution-only (no sibling dirty entries).

findings.gap: Acceptance and PC-013 rely on slice expectedPaths[], but schemas/workstream.json suggestedSlices has no expectedPaths field and no graph→path ownership table beyond node.locator. Without that, 'covered by spec at every path' is untestable and agents will invent ad-hoc rules.
findings.fixProposal: Add optional expectedPaths: string[] (globs ok) on suggestedSlices in schema + W-004 slices for packages/ui/**, packages/ledger/src/{audit,turns,reviews}/**, scripts/git-hooks/** before seal; document coverage algorithm in work-model.md one paragraph.

findings.gap: featureIds are [lattice, turns, verify] but related prior turn T-006 (same Lattice surface) touched client + server packages and claim SL-003/SL-005. Hooks/CI and FileDiff live under ui; align CLI may touch client HTTP. Omitting client/server understates blast and starves path coverage via graph locators.
findings.fixProposal: Extend featureIds to include client and server (or add explicit expectedPaths covering packages/client and packages/server for SLC-03/04). Update primaryFeatureId only if lattice remains the hero.

findings.gap: PC-014 and SLC-03 require code approve bound to treeDigest, but schemas/review.json has no treeDigest (or waiver) property. writeReview() only supports turn-scoped files; workstream/spec reviews are hand-written paths. Risk: treeDigest stuffed into untyped findings.evidence → weak gate.
findings.fixProposal: Before seal, amend acceptance to require schema+CLI changes in SLC-03: review.treeDigest?: string; optional waiver collection schema; listSpecReviews helper. Do not seal implying the field already exists.

findings.gap: correctnessCritical + cheap Haiku-class align agent can rubber-stamp approve. Acceptance says 'asks user for coverage intent' but does not require a machine-checkable checklist (uncovered path count == 0 OR waiver ids listed) inside the approve JSON. Free-text summary alone fails TN-001 spirit.
findings.fixProposal: Require approve reviews to cite killers or structured fields: uncoveredPaths: [] and coverageSource: user|graph|expectedPaths; refuse approve when uncoveredPaths non-empty unless waiver ids listed. Skill must say: cheap model fills checklist; user confirms coverage intent.

findings.gap: allowExplicitAlignSkip: true without constraints — a one-line waiver nullifies the whole gate. No min reason length, no severity, no audit failOn for naked waivers, no 'who' distinct from builder required in acceptance.
findings.fixProposal: Acceptance: waiver requires reason (>= N chars), actor, treeDigest, workstreamId; audit warns/fails on waiver without reason; policy.alignSkipMaxPerTurn default 1. Silence still ≠ skip.

findings.gap: Bet correctly keeps verify.ok claims-pure, but SLC-04 'CI job runs the same check' could be mistakenly folded into pnpm verify. Related SL-001/SL-008 already separate audit vs verify — acceptance should name the script (e.g. pnpm ledger:align or audit --fail-on align) explicitly.
findings.fixProposal: Name the CI step and npm script in acceptance; state verify workflow remains untouched.

findings.gap: SLC-01 absorbs large uncommitted UI polish already in the working tree (plan-first turns, density, FileDiff) that was implemented under done W-003 without a new turn — related T-006 treeDigestDrift already true. Seal without a residualRisk note invites repeating TN-002 breach mid-build.
findings.fixProposal: Add residualRisks: orphan UI diff must land only after seal under open T-00x for W-004 SLC-01; no further product UI until turn open. Optionally list current dirty UI paths in an attachment.

findings.gap: Acceptance 'skills/AGENTS instructions tell any host to use cheap model' is not e2e-checkable evidence. Without a committed skill file path in acceptance, hosts will ignore it.
findings.fixProposal: Name artifacts: skills/sl-dev-align/SKILL.md + AGENTS.md bullet; evidence = path exists + mentions Haiku/cheap model and user coverage ask.

findings.gap: worktreeCautions from related: scan is caution-only string, not structured sibling entries — residualRisk for multi-worktree agents remains soft.
findings.fixProposal: Copy into residualRisks; do not block seal on this alone.
